name: Stealth Keyboard
summary:
Stealth Keyboard is a distraction-free, zero-UI inline Japanese Input Method (IME) optimized for physical Bluetooth and USB keyboards on Meta Quest.

### Key Features
* **Zero-UI Inline Typing**: Visual input overlays and candidate windows are completely hidden, preserving full visibility of your VR workspace and text editors.
* **Smart Conversion Engine**: High-accuracy Japanese conversion powered by open-source Mozc dictionary (over 1.28M words) supporting compound phrases, inflections, and Katakana-to-En
